method.legacyClassification: The inherited counts/does-not-count/hard-case field addresses the earlier continuing-support test; expert protest events may remain visible despite does-not-count. Use importance, marker scope and verification status separately.
method.importance: Lowest display level; cumulative simple < standard < expert. Editorial judgement, separate from factual certainty.
method.marker: D2 = individual left governing side; D3 = named continuing-coalition dissent on a specific vote; D4 = sourced party/individual move between government and opposition; replacement = sourced seat-holder change; null = no supported marker.
method.markerScope: markerPersonIds restricts a marker on mixed events; factionIds are not an inferred roll call. No ideological left/right direction inferred.
method.timelineEligibility: timelineEligible=false marks duplicate evidence, routine unsuccessful motions or unconfirmed leads; importance does not override verification. Coalesce related official-decision and membership evidence.
method.replacement: Same-date list-level sets avoid arbitrary simultaneous pairings; candidatePositionHints are not a proved succession chain. Inferred reasons are labelled inferred-cohort.
method.gradingCoverage: All inherited events graded; additions and remaining research gaps are described separately in REPORT.md.

gradingCoverage.historicalCompleteness: partial; not an exhaustive census of qualifying votes, support changes or replacements

gaps: RB-IMP: all retained events have editorial grades; unrecorded historical events are not proved absent, and null markers mean evidence does not establish the requested marker.
